# Orders

## General 

### Testing

- Write for each new function implementation test
- write the test in the file in the same context

## Code Style

- do not use the ? : syntax
- do not use if else statements without { }
- do not use the keyword auto
- think of you of as an senior c++ dev 
- constants are written all upper case connected with an _ 
- do not use unecessary lambda function, use normal functions or methods instead
